clientSetup.appTypeNote: Register an app in Microsoft Entra (Azure portal) and add the Mobile and desktop applications platform — a public client needs no client secret. Any loopback port works for the redirect. The registration you use for Outlook or Microsoft 365 mail works too.
steps: Sign in at portal.azure.com and open Microsoft Entra ID, then App registrations, then New registration.
For supported account types choose 'Accounts in any organizational directory and personal Microsoft accounts'.
Under Authentication, add the 'Mobile and desktop applications' platform and enable the loopback redirect — any 127.0.0.1 port works.
No client secret is needed: this registration is a public client.
Gezel asks only for Files.Read (your own files) and offline access, which a person can approve for themselves.
Copy the Application (client) ID from the Overview page and paste it below.

notes: Mirrors one folder of the signed-in person's own OneDrive (or the whole OneDrive, when turned on) into one record per file with the file's folder path, type, size, dates, last editor, and web link. Files.Read covers only your own OneDrive: files other people shared with you are not included, and 'Add to My files' shortcuts and OneNote notebooks are skipped. The first sync records the drive's change position and then walks the folder, so edits made during the walk are not lost; later syncs read the drive's change feed and keep only what is inside the folder (Microsoft offers change tracking for a whole drive, not a single folder). Text and code files up to 512 KB appear in the record; Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, image, and other files up to the download limit (25 MB by default) are saved as attachments, and larger files are mirrored as details only. Downloads follow Microsoft's pre-signed links without sending your sign-in to them. Moves, renames, and deletions are reflected, including every file in a folder moved out of the synced folder. Personal OneDrive may report a deleted folder without its files; those records stay until the next full resync. The first sync mirrors at most 'Most files to mirror' files (2000 by default) and tracks at most 2000 folders; files beyond that appear only once they change. When Microsoft can no longer serve changes since the last sync, the folder is walked again.
